current_activity: remaining headquarters arrives; command post at Ducey
notes: Event date: Breakout-18 p344: part of XII Corps headquarters reached Normandy on 29 July and the remainder on 7 August; the CMH command-post list (World War II by Day) gives Ducey-les-Chéris on 7 August. Event definition: the corps headquarters completes its arrival; the date is when the remainder arrived, not when the corps took a sector. Location: commune centroid. Relationship: Third Army assigned.

current_activity: assembling at Le Mans to take over the southern flank of Third Army
notes: Wikipedia: XII Corps (Cook) reached Le Mans on 13 August; CMH tables show the 4th Armored and 35th Divisions passing to XII Corps on 13 August.

current_activity: Eddy replaces Cook as corps commander
notes: Wikipedia: Cook commanded until 18 August and Eddy from 19 August; the CMH 9th Division page shows Eddy leaving that division on 19 August. Corps command post not located; point is the Orléans area.

Breakout-28 p583: CCA of the 4th Armored Division attacked Troyes on the morning of 25 August; p588 counts the XII and XX Corps Seine bridgeheads. Objective check (Batch 2 review): the corps was attacking at the town on the row date, so documented_on_date holds.
Lorraine Campaign p4: Third Army crossed the Meuse at Verdun and Commercy on 31 August; Wikipedia assigns Commercy to XII Corps.

current_activity: 4th Armored and 35th Divisions crossing the Moselle near Bayon
notes: Lorraine-2 p71: the armor attacked on the morning of 11 September on the right of the 35th Division, one column to cross near Bayon and one at Bainville-aux-Miroirs.

current_activity: establishing the Dieulouard bridgehead across the Moselle
notes: Lorraine-2 p76–77: the Dieulouard sector was quiet until 12 September; Wikipedia dates the crossing to 13 September.
Wikipedia: XII Corps reached Nancy and Lunéville on 15–16 September; XV Corps accounts date Lunéville to 22 September.

current_activity: 4th Armored Division defeating Fifth Panzer Army counterattacks at Arracourt
notes: Lorraine-5 p222–224: German armored attacks at Arracourt on 19–22 September; Patton visited Arracourt from army headquarters at Étain.

current_activity: opens the Lorraine offensive across the Seille
notes: Event date: 8 November 1944 (Lorraine p317: Patton gave the code words "Play ball" which were to begin the XII Corps advance on the morning of 8 November; p351: at 0500 on 8 November the XII Corps artillery began firing in preparation for the Seille crossing). Event definition: XII Corps' Seille crossing is the opening move of the Third Army's November offensive; the XX Corps attack at Metz follows on 9 November. Relationship: Third Army assigned. Location: Corps command post at Essey-lès-Nancy from 12 October (atlas); the next atlas entry, Morhange, is 23 November, so the earlier one is used. Coordinates: Wikipedia (fr): Nancy. Event support: high (two Green Book statements). Location support: low (a 27-day gap to the nearest earlier atlas entry; the later entry, Morhange, is 15 days after and well east of the start line).

current_activity: ordered to disengage in the Saar and move its command post to Luxembourg City
notes: Event date: 19 December 1944 (Ardennes p487: after the Verdun meeting a telephone call from Verdun told the Third Army chief of staff that the XII Corps was to disengage at once and that "the command post of Eddy's corps and an advance command post for the Third Army" were to transfer to Luxembourg City; Ardennes p486 puts the Verdun meeting on the morning of the 19th). The date of the actual move is not given. Event definition: the XII Corps, previously on the Saar front, is turned north to take over the east flank of the Bulge; the row is the order, not the arrival in Luxembourg City. Relationship: Third Army assigned. Location: The atlas lists the corps command post at Luxembourg on 23 December, four days after the order; Luxembourg City is the place the Green Book orders it to. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Luxembourg City. Event support: high for the order, low for the move date. Location support: low (four days between the order and the atlas entry; no narrative for the arrival).
